bullets: Retired the MiniMax M3 model, removing it from the list of available choices and switching the free coding assistant's default to a different model.
Updated the model picker to show a 'Leaving' label for three models that are soon to be removed, instead of the previous price-related warning.
Switched the fast, parallel-agent model to run on a new service, then reverted it back to the provider's own servers after the new service was too slow.
Made the coding assistant's tool use more reliable by automatically correcting common mistakes when interpreting your requests.
Updated the assistant to check if your to-do list is finished before asking you to write a final answer, so unfinished work takes priority.
Added a new way for advertisers to draft sponsored skills using a guided format, making it easier to specify what a developer should build.
Removed the pre-approval hint from the sponsored task card that previously described the number of steps and time involved.
Added a new preview feature that allows you to see the full details of a sponsored task and accept it in a single step.
Updated the instructions for the fast-mode coding assistant to require a more thorough check of its own work, including running tests.
